newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed on Tuesday on higher turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE).
A shares were unchanged from Monday's $114 and B fell slightly to $117.750 from $117.875.
Turnover in SOLIDERE shares rose to 10,684 shares from 8,729 on Monday and value was $1,225,938 from $1,010,197.63.
Also traded were 1,000 shares of Ciments Libanais at $1.3125, unchanged from October 11 when they were last traded.
There was no trade in the three other listed companies: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic, none of which were traded in the last three weeks.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.02 percent to 84.59 and the BLOM stock index also fell 0.05 percent to 984.82.
